paymentTerminalSettings.sandboxBanner: You are viewing the sandbox environment. These settings are for test payments only and do not affect live store checkout.
paymentTerminalSettings.squareNotConfiguredHint: No {{environment}} token is set. POS devices on this environment cannot take Square payments.
paymentTerminalSettings.squareClearConfirmDescription: POS devices on this environment will not be able to take Square payments until a new token is set.
paymentTerminalSettings.squareTokenModalHint: The token is only sent when you save and is never shown again. Saving replaces the current shared {{environment}} token for every store that has no token of its own.
paymentTerminalSettings.stepAddTerminalsTodo: No terminals yet. Use Add terminal.
paymentTerminalSettings.stepCredentialsBlocked: Missing password for: {{names}}. Edit the terminal and enter the password again.
paymentTerminalSettings.stepPairTodo: Enter the Pair Code in the POS settings screen
paymentTerminalSettings.stepAssignNone: No POS uses a Cloud terminal yet. You can assign after activation.
paymentTerminalSettings.activateBlockedHint: Complete the checks above to activate
paymentTerminalSettings.issueConflict: {{devices}} all selected {{terminal}}. A payment terminal can only belong to one POS.
paymentTerminalSettings.issueNotReady: {{device}} selected {{terminal}}, which is not paired yet.
paymentTerminalSettings.issueOrphan: {{device}} no longer exists but still holds {{terminal}}. Clear it in the POS list below.
paymentTerminalSettings.pairHint: After adding, enter the Pair Code in the settings screen of the POS that uses this terminal.
paymentTerminalSettings.pairingHintUnpaired: Waiting for Pair Code on POS
paymentTerminalSettings.squareStoreSelectHint: Select a store first, then set a token for that store.
paymentTerminalSettings.squareStoreFallbackShared: {{store}} has no token of its own and uses the shared token.
paymentTerminalSettings.squareStoreNoToken: {{store}} has no token of its own and there is no shared {{environment}} token, so it cannot take Square payments.
paymentTerminalSettings.squareStoreClearConfirmDescription: This store will fall back to the shared token (if set). Other stores are not affected.
paymentTerminalSettings.squareStoreCleared: Store token cleared. This store now uses the shared token.
paymentTerminalSettings.squareStoreTokenModalHint: The token is only sent when you save and is never shown again. It applies to {{store}} only; other stores keep using their own token or the shared token.
paymentTerminalSettings.squareDirectMetaSelectStore: Select a store first to turn direct Square on or off for it.
paymentTerminalSettings.squareDirectMetaOff: Off: this store's registers go through the POS server, as before.
paymentTerminalSettings.squareDirectMetaOn: On: this store's registers may connect to Square directly. A short-lived token is sent to each register.
paymentTerminalSettings.squareDirectBlockedNotReady: The direct-connect table does not exist yet. Deploy the new POS API first.
paymentTerminalSettings.squareDirectBlockedNoToken: This store has no active Square token. Set a shared or store-specific token first.
paymentTerminalSettings.squareDirectEnableConfirmDescription: The store's registers will get a Square token (valid 12 hours) and connect to Square themselves. Turning it off here stops new tokens; registers drop theirs within 12 hours.
